player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop trying to put the delly in the thot, but I never actually opened the thot to make it possible to put the delly inside. Next time, I will make sure to open the thot before trying to put the delly in it. I will also check if the thot is already open before trying to put the delly in it. If it is open, I will try to put the delly in it. If it is not open, I will open it first.
